title: Michael Kellermann Foundation
description: Public site for MKF, a recovery foundation that funds private treatment and aftercare so people are not lost in a revolving-door clinic. Built around donate, programs, stories, and family support.
descriptionEs: Sitio público de MKF, una fundación de recuperación que financia tratamiento privado y aftercare para que nadie se pierda en un sistema de puertas giratorias. Incluye donaciones, programas, testimonios y apoyo familiar.
achievements: Live site at mkfrecovery.org with donate, programs, and contact paths
Mission, recovery stories, and 30/60/90-day program structure
Quiet visual system around hope, sobriety, and community
